TASK: Assign one bug-hunt session to Bug Hunter A (apptester-3) and one to Bug Hunter B (apptester-4) against the most recently built app. Use team.dispatch.

1. Read /status/status.md and /support/bug-hunts.md to see which apps are built and what was found last.
2. Pick the newest fully-built app (calculator, security-auditor, or income-reconciliation).
3. Dispatch Bug Hunter A (apptester-3) with focus: edge cases, security issues, and usability problems.
4. Dispatch Bug Hunter B (apptester-4) with focus: accessibility, performance, and cross-browser issues.
